# Job Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 419v–420r

---

**10:1** "My-soul [nafshiy] is-weary-of [naqetah] my-life [be-chayyay];
I-will-give-free-rein [e'ezvah] to-my-complaint [sichiy] upon-me;
I-will-speak [adabberah] in-the-bitterness [be-mar] of-my-soul [nafshiy].

**10:2** I-will-say [omar] to God [eloah], 'Do-not condemn-me [al tarshi'eniy];
make-me-know [hodi'eniy] why [al mah] you-contend [teriveniy] with-me.'

**10:3** Is-it-good [ha-tov] for-you that you-oppress [ta'ashoq],
that you-despise [timmas] the-labor [yegi'a] of-your-hands [kappeykha],
and-upon the-counsel [atsat] of-the-wicked [resha'im] you-shine [hofa'ta]?

**10:4** Do-you-have-eyes [ha-einei] of-flesh [vasar] [are] to-you,
or as-sees [yir'eh] a-mortal [enosh] do-you-see [tir'eh]?

**10:5** Are-your-days [ha-yamekha] like-the-days of-a-mortal [enosh],
or your-years [shenotekha] like-the-days of-a-man [gever],

**10:6** that you-seek-out [tevaqesh] my-iniquity [la-avoniy]
and-for-my-sin [u-le-chattatiy] you-search [tidrosh]?

**10:7** You-know [al da'atekha] that I-am-not guilty [lo ersha],
and-there-is-none [ve-ein] who-delivers [mattsil] from-your-hand [mi-yadekha].

**10:8** Your-hands [yadeykha] shaped-me [itstsevuniy] and-made-me [vayya'asuniy]
together [yachad] all-around [saviv]; and-you-swallow-me-up [vateballei'eniy]!

**10:9** Remember [zekhor] now that like-clay [ka-chomer] you-made-me [asitaniy],
and-to dust [ve-el afar] you-will-return-me [teshiveniy].

**10:10** Did-you-not like-milk [ke-chalav] pour-me-out [tattikheniy],
and-like-cheese [ve-ka-gevinah] curdle-me [taqpi'eniy]?

**10:11** With-skin [or] and-flesh [basar] you-clothed-me [talbisheniy],
and-with-bones [u-va-atsamot] and-sinews [ve-gidim] you-wove-me-together [tesokhekeniy].

**10:12** Life [chayyim] and-steadfast-love [ve-chesed] you-granted [asita] with-me [immadiy],
and-your-care [u-fequddatekha] preserved [shamerah] my-spirit [ruchiy].

**10:13** And-these [ve-elleh] you-hid [tsafanta] in-your-heart [bi-levavekha];
I-know [yada'tiy] that this [zot] [was] with-you [immakh].

**10:14** If I-sin [chatati], you-watch-me [u-shemartaniy],
and-from-my-iniquity [me-avoniy] you-will-not acquit-me [lo tenaqqeniy].

**10:15** If I-am-wicked [im rashati] — woe to-me [allay liy];
and-[if] I-am-righteous [ve-tsadaqtiy], I-cannot lift [lo essa] my-head [roshiy],
full [seva] of-shame [qalon] and-look [u-re'eh] upon-my-affliction [onyiy].

**10:16** And-if-it-rises [ve-yig'eh], like-a-lion [ka-shachal] you-hunt-me [tetsudeniy],
and-again [ve-tashuv] you-show-yourself-wonderful [titpalla] against-me.

**10:17** You-renew [techadesh] your-witnesses [edekha] against-me,
and-you-increase [ve-tarbeh] your-anger [ka'askha] with-me;
changes-and-warfare [chalifot ve-tsava] [are] with-me.

**10:18** And-why [ve-lammah] from-the-womb [me-rechem] did-you-bring-me-out [hotse'taniy]?
I-would-have-expired [egva] and-no eye [ein] would-have-seen-me [tir'eniy].

**10:19** As-if [ka-asher] I-had-not been [lo hayitiy] I-would-be;
from-the-womb [mi-beten] to-the-grave [la-qever] I-would-be-carried [uval].

**10:20** Are-not few [me'at] my-days [yamay]? Let-him-cease [yechdal];
let-him-set [yashit] from-me [mimeniy] and-I-will-brighten-up [va-avliyah] a-little [me'at],

**10:21** before [be-terem] I-go [elekh] and-I-will-not return [ve-lo ashub],
to-a-land of-darkness [choshekh] and-deep-shadow [tsalmaveth],

**10:22** a-land of-gloom [eifatah] like-thick-darkness [ke-ofel],
deep-shadow [tsalmaveth] and-without-order [ve-lo sedarim],
and-it-shines [vattofah] like-thick-darkness [ke-mo ofel]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.8-12 — Creation imagery:** Iyyov employs an extraordinary range of creation metaphors: potter and clay (v.9), milk and cheese (v.10), skin and bone (v.11). The sequence moves from conception through gestation to birth, arguing that the God who so carefully formed him is now destroying his own work.

**v.10 — "like milk poured me out, like cheese curdled me":** The *chalav* (milk) and *gevinah* (cheese) imagery is a remarkably concrete description of embryonic development — liquid becoming solid, form emerging from formlessness.

**v.22 — "it shines like thick darkness":** The final oxymoron — *vattofah ke-mo ofel* (it shines like darkness) — is one of the most haunting lines in the book. Even light in Sheol is darkness. The description accumulates four synonyms for darkness (*choshekh*, *tsalmaveth*, *eifatah*, *ofel*), creating a verbal void.

---
*— EMET*
